decision: Retain the prior inconclusive-stop decision, unspecified production measurement policy and v1 persistence. Keep scoped-cache work parked. Neither a generic confirmation rule nor a default preference follows from this audit.

findings.statement: Original and confirmation profiling retain the same actual M144/N1024/K3072 geometry, six tensor buffers, runner, finalist descriptor and nominal settings. M256 is the lookup/enumeration bucket, not actual measured M.

Settings remain unspecified-policy, hot-L2 non-graph event timing, three warmups, ten timed launches and a requested5000us delay. Each returned average is one event window, not ten independent observations.

Confirmation occurs after all81 original profiles and cache publication, operand hashing, FP32 reference work and repeated preparation. It uses twelve balanced pairs and adds NaN output fill/device synchronization before each call and numerical checks/device synchronization after. Preparation is once per runner/profile or confirmation group, not once per candidate.

Block5 initial explicit/default ratio0.9378725738 becomes1.0682724118 in confirmation and1.0690340966 in retained graph scoring. All12 confirmation pairs are retained: explicit slower8, faster4. Both first-position strata favor default descriptively. No cause is identified.

All192 confirmation profiler host envelopes are240.450–447.960us (median259.535us) despite the requested5000us delay. All subsequent correctness intervals are at least5168.105us (median5216.260us); those intervals include device-wide synchronization and numerical work, not isolated delay timing.

Exact FlashInfer delay code passes only an integer and reads the FFI current stream; profiling events use the PyTorch current stream. Reviewed upstream FFI source derives streams from tensor arguments and restores ambient state after each call. This can leave a tensor-free delay on a different stream. The reviewed FFI binding is not proven identical to the historical installed binding, and no runtime stream handles/delay trace were saved.

The native delay uses approximate nanosleep calls; its configured integer is not a guaranteed wall-clock delay. Short host envelopes and later synchronization work do not independently prove wrong-stream execution.
